spanish: Y no dejarán de él hasta la mañana, y el restante de él hasta la mañana en el fuego quemarán.
grammarChanges: Added the article to 'hasta la mañana' (both occurrences, h02012010005/h02012010009) so the noun 'morning' is not read as the idiom 'hasta mañana' (until tomorrow).
readerNote: hold: clause role — the suffix on מִמֶּנּוּ (h02012010003/h02012010007) is parsed 1cp, which decides who/what the preposition 'from' is taken from; choosing between that and the contextual 3ms referent is a participant call, so 'de él' is left unchanged.
